newsitem.title: ITALY: Swiss firm Air Engiadina launches Rome-Berne route.
newsitem.headline: Swiss firm Air Engiadina launches Rome-Berne route.

text.p: Swiss airline Air Engiadina on Wednesday launched a Rome-Berne service aimed at business travellers, the company which manages Rome's airports said.
The airline will fly Dornier 38 planes, which seat 31 people, six times a week between Ciampino airport and Berne.

"We're very pleased about the arrival of this new company because it is a step towards boosting Rome ahead of the Jubilee," Fabrizio Fabrizi of Aeroporti di Roma told reporters at the launch of the new service.
Pope John Paul has declared the year 2000 a holy year or jubilee and thousands of Roman Catholics are expected to fly in.
